title: receiveTypingIndicators: checked at delivery time, not subscribe time
description: Both draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md and jmap-chat-wss-guide.md explicitly require checking receiveTypingIndicators at event delivery time, not at ChatStreamEnable subscribe time. Chat preferences can change while a WebSocket connection is open; a subscribe-time-only check would silently deliver suppressed events to users who changed the preference mid-session. The implementer's guide reinforces this by placing the receiveTypingIndicators check in the delivery path alongside the membership check, not at subscription setup.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
